listing.name: Eradicator Ship Pack
listing.summary: A ship Pack for Eradicator based cruisers.
listing.aiSummary: Adds several new cruisers and support ships to the Eradicator faction.

description:
Eradicator Ship Pack
A ship Pack for Eradicator based cruisers.

Requirements: None
Conflicts: None, it should work with any mods, if this proves to be untrue, please let me know.

Download Here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uHFZsMd-y8BN-k2HD-7IE0-GpxZUcDbJ/view?usp=sharing

Ships Added:
-The Eliminator - A fast strike carrier and low tech alternative to the Heron.

-The Eviscerator - A dedicated gunboat and escort ship born with a hatred for all things smaller than itself.

-The Exterminator - An artillery cruiser meant to bring some heavy weapons to every Eradicator party. (New Sprite courtesy of Great Wound)

-The Extirpator - A combat logistics ship meant to extend the range of Eradicator squadrons while still being able to bring some pain.

-The Expunger- A combat logistics ship meant to extend the supply and personnel requirements of Eradicator squadrons while still being able to bring some pain.

-The Excoriator- A missile boat with a lot of speed and burst firepower.

-The Evaporator- A [REDACTED]

Spoiler
Changelog - 1.1
Ships Added:
Evaporator - Fast [REDACTED] -beware the ghosts of the AI wars.
Excoriator - Fast Missile Cruiser - BY LUDD'S LIGHT I BANISH THEE!
Expunger - Fast Combat Freighter - Marines and Munitions, 30 minutes delivery or your order is free!

Changes Made:
Extirpator:
Extirpator DP and Supply usage dropped to 15 (was 20)
Added additional Medium Ballistic turret.
Extirpator Fleet Point reduced to 8 (was 20)

Exterminator:
Exterminator Reworked and Resprited (Thank you Great Wound)
System changed to Lidar Array (was Maneuvering Jets)
Added Decorative weapon slot for Lidar Array system.
Changed Composite Large Mount to Hybrid.
Removed Torpedo variant, added Lancer variant. Will give low tech cruisers access to large energy weapons.
Fleet Points reduced to 14

Modder Note: Rework is an attempt to make the Exterminator a better siege platform. Ship was overperforming against lighter targets thanks to maneuvering jets and missile/torpedos from its large slot.
Rework will hopefully give it more identity in its intended role.

Eviscerator:
Eviscerator Reworked and Resprited
Medium mount replaced with large mount.
Built In Flak Gun replaced with Built In Devestator Cannon.
Reduced number of small ballistic mounts to 12 (was 14).
Removed frontal composite mounts.
Ship armor reduced to 1000 (was 1200) and Hull reduced to 8000 (was 9000)
Ship Top speed increased to 90 (was 75). Ship maneuverability increased by 10 across the board.
Built in Hull Mod changed from armored weapon mounts to advanced turret gyros.
Changed Description to be more in-line with in game lore.
Fleet Points reduced to 13

Modder Note: Ship rework came from the Eviscerator being kind of worthless. It was as fast as an Eradicator, but was still not fast enough to catch frigates or intercept fighters well
and did not have as effective an armament so struggled against anything bigger than a destroyer. In addition, it's role as flak cruiser has been entirely supplanted by the Anubis. This rework is in the hopes to make it a bigger threat to
fighters and frigates, and a moderate threat to heavier targets thanks to an increase in speed and firepower, but not a de-facto improvment over the regular Eradicator who remains
tougher by an appreciable margin.

Eliminator:
Added 1 additional ballistic medium turret
Removed Recovery Shuttles built in hull mod.
Fleet Points reduced to 13
Changed description to be more in-line with in game lore.

Modders Note: Fleet points were extremely high due to me misunderstanding what fleet points were. I thought they were the deployment cost of ships, instead these vessels we being overvalued for their size category for skill and autobattle calculations. Whoops.

Please note that this is my first mod I have ever made for this game. I used parts from the Kitbash database and the modding guide on the wiki in order to try and make this work. If there are any issues or problems please let me know.

aiDescription: Adds a fast strike carrier, a dedicated gunboat, an artillery cruiser, two combat logistics ships, a missile boat, and a stealth ship. The update reworks existing ships to improve their balance and identity, adjusting stats, weapons, and fleet points.
